component.name: Chatpane
component.summary: A focused desktop client for Facebook Messenger

description.p: Chatpane wraps Messenger in a small native desktop window and removes the surrounding Facebook feed, Reels, Marketplace, and other distractions.
It provides native notifications, unread indicators, keyboard shortcuts, system theme integration, privacy controls, and a system tray.

description.p: Improved recovery when Messenger stops responding or limits requests, and added clearer camera and microphone troubleshooting.
Restored native desktop menus and improved Linux Wayland startup.
Completed Linux desktop integration and cut Messenger memory and CPU use.
Improved Messenger reliability and reduced Linux WebKit memory use.
Fixed notification hydration and conversation routing.
Added stronger privacy, notification, and desktop integration controls.
Expanded native desktop behavior and Messenger page integration.
